description:
APPLICATION FOR THE ERECTION OF A PROPOSED PART SINGLE AND
PART TWO STOREY REAR EXTENSION, TWO STOREY SIDE EXTENSION AND REAR ROOF
EXTENSIONS (HIP TO GABLE AND REAR DORMER) WITH 3 X NEW ROOFLIGHTS TO THE FRONT
ELEVATION.
